verses.2: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.
verses.3: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
verses.4: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.
verses.6: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,
verses.7: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?
verses.12: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.
verses.13: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

verses.23: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.
